Definition: from the base of G977; (abstractly) eating (literally or figuratively); by extension (concretely) food (literally or figuratively):--eating, food, meat.
BiblicalUsage: brōsis is simply eating, and by extension, food. Scripture uses it in 1 Corinthians, and the context leaves nothing to guess at.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that brōsis is no exception: no word in Scripture is filler.
